facts.fact: EITI says Ghana is developing a new digital business registration system with the Office of the Registrar of Companies, expected to be fully functional by 2026.
EITI says 175,984 companies had filed beneficial ownership data with the Office of the Registrar of Companies as of 30 September 2025, up from 24,256 in 2021.
